title: A planned item that replays or rewrites commits carries a check-trailers check, so its done fails before the push does
goal: The plan step of the sprint skill names that an item whose work replays, rebases or rewrites commits (repro replay, a cherry-pick of another clone's history) carries the check python3 _tools/kbgit.py check-trailers origin/main..HEAD, so a trailer the sync gate refuses fails the item's done in the worker's worktree, not the landing; the command form the rule gives exits 0 on a clean branch

run: import sys;s=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## plan')[1].split('## start')[0];sys.exit(0 if 'check-trailers origin/main..HEAD' in s else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-bhzxxhub: ST-apmeih5l's done passed all seven checks, then land stopped at kbgit.py sync --push (check-trailers bad=7: each replayed backlog-planning commit carried a second KB-Work line); the orchestrator rewrote the 7 commits by hand. The code defect is BG-gg3aohlm. Plan 2026-10-15: the check now reads the plan section of the skill only, and a second check runs the rule's own command form. Code-lane path (skills/sprint/SKILL.md): lands with land --wait-merge. Checks that pass before the work: check 1, kbgit.py check-trailers origin/main..HEAD (the rule's own command form, passing on a clean branch) pass before the work and are kept as guards (the change must keep them green); check 0 fails before the work and reads the goal. Each guard check named above as passing on the base passes before the work: it pins behaviour that must stay green (a test selection the work extends, the eval, the lint); the item's failing checks read its goal.
